verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs say a URL can be scraped into HTML, alongside markdown and JSON, and they reference a `scrape` endpoint, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence does not show whether the HTML returned is the page's raw, unmodified source or a cleaned version. Single-call request and response details are only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a raw (unprocessed) HTML output format, documentation of the single scrape request returning HTML, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back
